title: hydration-job.json
description: Job descriptor for detached model weight hydration worker (FS-706 §3.3, D-R8).

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this hydration task.

target.description: Model target artifact slug from enclave.lock.toml.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the job was dispatched.

dmg_path.description: Optional filesystem path to pre-staged DMG image for Profile L3.
